title: introduce-presubmit-fastpath-and-rolling-lockfile-updater
author: Maya Kline
description:
Summary: Adds a lightweight presubmit "fastpath" runner that skips expensive integration shards for small/targeted changes, plus a rolling lockfile updater (lockfile-roller) that incrementally tests and lands dependency updates behind a canary gate.

Motivation: CI costs and turnaround time have drifted up as the repo grew; many changes touch a small surface area and don't need full integration runs. Separately, prod-facing repos suffer from out-of-date lockfiles; full dependabot rollups create noisy PRs and break CI.

This PR introduces: 
1) presubmit-fastpath: a change-aware presubmit lane implemented as a single GitHub Action and a small Go runner that classifies changed paths and maps them to test profiles. Fastpath runs:
 - quick-lint (cached)
 - unit-tests shard(s) for touched packages
 - small smoke on core runtime for infra touches
2) lockfile-roller: a service-run script + action that:
 - generates incremental dependency bumps for npm/python/helm locks
 - runs canary job (fastpath + targeted integration)
 - posts CI results and, if green, opens a staged PR with release notes and pinned version metadata

Implementation notes:
 - New action: .github/actions/presubmit-fastpath.yml wires to the runtime that queries changed files and invokes the fastpath runner.
 - New CLI: ci/fastpath/runner.go (400 LOC) contains deterministic change->profile mapping and telemetry hooks.
 - Lockfile roller: scripts/lockfile-roller/{runner.sh,canary-check.go,pr-builder.py} implement the generate->test->open flow.
 - Metrics: telemetry emitted to metrics.redwood.internal (events: presubmit.fastpath.skipped, presubmit.fastpath.duration, lockfile.roller.canary_pass)
 - Safety: lockfile-roller executes each bump in ephemeral ephemeral-workspaces using devcontainer-style manifests and requires an explicit Linear opt-in for major upgrades (ENG-2019)

Commits (summary):
 - 3a7d8f2: add presubmit-fastpath action and docs
 - cb2f1e6: implement go runner + unit tests
 - e8d9c50: add lockfile-roller scripts + canary harness
 - 7b12a4d: add telemetry and metrics + unit test flakiness fixes
 - d4f0b9a: update release automation to accept staged-lockfile PRs

Changed files (high-level):
 - .github/actions/presubmit-fastpath.yml
 - ci/fastpath/runner.go
 - ci/fastpath/runner_test.go
 - scripts/lockfile-roller/runner.sh
 - scripts/lockfile-roller/canary-check.go
 - scripts/lockfile-roller/pr-builder.py
 - docs/ci/fastpath.md
 - docs/ci/lockfile-roller.md
 - .github/workflows/presubmit.yml (hook into fastpath)
 - package-lock.json (example canary bump)
 - pyproject.lock (example canary bump)

Small illustrative snippet (presubmit action):

name: presubmit-fastpath\ndescription: "Run lightweight presubmit for small changes"\non: [pull_request]\njobs:\n  fastpath:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v3\n      - name: Run presubmit fastpath\n        uses: ./github/actions/presubmit-fastpath\n        with:\n          base: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}\n          head: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}\n

Review notes (conversation):
 - Jordan Li: "Nice. Can you add a counter for skipped full-integration runs so we can quantify savings? Also make sure fastpath is disabled for release/* branches."
 - Maya Kline: "Added presubmit.fastpath.skipped metric and branch guard; updated docs. See commit 7b12a4d."
 - Priya Natarajan: "Lockfile roller looks powerful; please gate major bumps behind a Linear opt-in and add a flag for dry-run-only."
 - Maya Kline: "Implemented opt-in via linear tags and dry-run mode. The canary-check returns nonzero on failure so the action marks status appropriately."
 - Carlos Mendes: "A couple of nits on logging and error propagation in canary-check.go; added suggestions."
 - Maya Kline: "Addressed Carlos' suggestions and added integration test to cover pr-builder edge cases (cb2f1e6 -> d4f0b9a)."

CI summary:
 - Initial run: lint passed, unit-tests shard-2 failed once (flaky test testKVCacheRace). Failure traced to test timing; test stabilized by adding retry in runner_test.go.
 - Rerun: all checks passed.
 - Lockfile canary run: one canary bump showed transient network failure to registry; lockfile-roller will retry up to 3 times before marking canary fail. Run succeeded on second attempt.

Rollout and merge:
 - PR approved by Jordan Li and Priya Natarajan.
 - Merge method: squash, commit message consolidated with canary report summary.
 - Merged by release-bot after green e2e in release candidate lane (2026-02-20).

Backwards compatibility and release notes:
 - No breaking API changes. Fastpath is opt-in via .github/fastpath-config.yml and defaults to conservative mapping; teams can opt-out per package.
 - Release notes: "Introduce presubmit fastpath to reduce CI cost and improve feedback on small changes; add rolling lockfile-roller to safely increment dependency versions via canaries."

Linear links / follow-ups:
 - ENG-2019: add repo-level opted packages for fastpath mapping
 - ENG-2147: expand lockfile-roller to support go modules and helm chart dependencies

Post-merge actions (tracked):
 - Monitor presubmit.fastpath.skipped and presubmit.fastpath.duration for two weeks.
 - Run a clean-up job to backfill opt-outs for repos flagged by the fastpath scanner.

Edge cases and known limitations:
 - Fastpath is conservative; changes touching build/infra will still run full integration.
 - lockfile-roller currently supports npm and pyproject; go modules planned in follow-up (ENG-2147).
